checks.note: The excerpt is exact, and the axis, horizon and outcome match the reviews. The rationale gets a date wrong: it says Morris et al. proposed the framework on June 5, 2024. The arXiv context shows it was first submitted on 4 Nov 2023 (v1). June 5, 2024 is only when v4 was revised. Say 'a version available June 5, 2024' or give the 2023 origin.
